trans-unit.note: Menu item shown when keyboard-only mode is off. Keep short: appears in the macOS menu bar dropdown.
Menu item shown when keyboard-only mode is on (replaces menu.clean_screen). Keep short.
Menu checkbox item toggling keyboard-only mode.
Menu submenu title grouping the cleaning color choice (Black/White).
Menu submenu item: the black cleaning screen color.
Menu submenu item: the white cleaning screen color.
Menu submenu title grouping the fail-safe auto-unlock delay choices.
Menu checkbox: whether to keep showing the Urahafu icon in the menu bar.
Menu checkbox: whether Urahafu launches automatically at login.
Menu item opening the About alert.
Tray menu item opening the settings window (Apple's standard term for this kind of item).
Menu item quitting the app.

Menu item shown above 'Clean Screen'/'Clean Keyboard' (followed by a separator) only while Accessibility access is missing; opens System Settings on the Accessibility pane. Disappears once access is granted.
Title of the app's second main-menu bar menu, holding only a 'Close' item. Apple's standard term for this menu; translate it the way macOS itself does in this language.
Item in the 'Window' main-menu bar menu (⌘W), closes the settings window. Apple's standard term for this item; translate it the way macOS itself does in this language.
Label shown above the big countdown digit before cleaning starts. Unlike the digit itself (3, 2, 1) this text does not change between seconds, so it must not reference a specific count.
Small hint below the countdown digit explaining how to cancel it.
The app's wordmark shown on the full-screen cleaning overlay. This is a proper noun (the app's name) and must stay 'urahafu', unchanged, in every language.

trans-unit.source: Hold the close button or Esc + Return for 2 seconds to unlock
trans-unit.target: החזיקו את כפתור הסגירה או Esc + Return למשך 2 שניות כדי לשחרר את הנעילה
trans-unit.note: Full-screen overlay hint explaining the hold-to-unlock gesture: either the close button, or holding Esc and Return together. Spells out 'close button' in words rather than using the ✕ glyph inline: next to a number ('✕ 2 seconds') the glyph would read as a multiplication sign. 'Esc' and 'Return' must be Apple's own localized names for those keys in this language (as printed in macOS's keyboard-shortcut notation and documentation, e.g. French 'Échap' and 'Retour'), joined with '+' exactly as here. Never use ✕ or × anywhere in this string.

trans-unit.source: To unlock, hold the close button or Esc + Return for 2 seconds
trans-unit.target: כדי לשחרר את הנעילה, החזיקו את כפתור הסגירה או Esc + Return למשך 2 שניות
trans-unit.note: Countdown screen's explanation of the hold-to-unlock gesture, shown while the countdown to locking is still running: either the close button, or holding Esc and Return together. Same wording constraints as overlay.hint.hold_to_unlock: spell out the button, use Apple's own localized key names for Esc/Return joined with '+', never use ✕ or ×.
Keyboard-only mode HUD: compact pill shown while the keyboard is locked. Keep this very short, it renders in a small rounded pill.

trans-unit.source: Hold the button or Esc + Return 2 s
trans-unit.target: החזק את הכפתור או Esc + Return 2 שנ׳
trans-unit.note: Keyboard-only mode HUD: compact hold-to-unlock hint next to the ✕ button, mentioning the Esc+Return keyboard combo too. Keep very short (HUD pill). Spell out 'button' in words; 'Esc' and 'Return' must be Apple's own localized key names in this language, joined with '+' exactly as here; never use ✕ or × inline next to the number.
Default button of the first-launch alert, opens System Settings.

trans-unit.source: Urahafu needs Accessibility access to block the keyboard and trackpad while you clean.
trans-unit.target: Urahafu זקוק לגישת נגישות כדי לחסום את המקלדת ואת משטח המגע בזמן הניקוי.
trans-unit.note: Banner shown at the top of the settings window while Accessibility access is missing, next to a button reusing first_launch.open_settings. The Clean button is disabled while this banner is visible.
Small secondary note shown under the settings window's disabled 'Open at Login' checkbox, explaining why it's disabled (no menu bar icon to normally reach it from).

trans-unit.source: During cleaning, press Space to test for dead pixels.
trans-unit.target: בזמן הניקוי, הקישו Space כדי לבדוק פיקסלים מתים.
trans-unit.note: Small secondary label in the settings window, shown under countdown.unlock_explanation, explaining the dead-pixel test (Space cycles the screen through red/green/blue/white/black during cleaning).

Settings window: one segment label of the auto-unlock delay's segmented control. {seconds} is always one of 30/60/90, formatted with Western digits regardless of language. Keep very short (it's a segment label, not a sentence) — a unit abbreviation, not a full word, if this language has one.
Title of the error alert shown when Accessibility access is missing at cleaning time.

trans-unit.source: Urahafu can't block the keyboard without this permission. Cleaning did not start.
trans-unit.target: Urahafu לא יכול לחסום את המקלדת בלי ההרשאה הזו. הניקוי לא התחיל.
trans-unit.note: Body of the permission-missing error alert.
Default button of the permission-missing alert, opens System Settings.
Title of the error alert shown when the keyboard event tap could not be installed.

trans-unit.source: Cleaning did not start so you never get stuck. Try again; if it keeps happening, log out and back in.
trans-unit.target: הניקוי לא התחיל כדי שלא תיתקע. נסה שוב; אם זה ממשיך לקרות, התנתק והתחבר מחדש.
trans-unit.note: Body of the event-tap-failed error alert, suggests retrying or logging out and back in.
Title of the error alert shown when macOS Secure Input is blocking Urahafu.

trans-unit.source: Another app (often an open password field) is preventing Urahafu from blocking the keyboard. Close that field or app, then try again.
trans-unit.target: אפליקציה אחרת (לרוב שדה סיסמה פתוח) מונעת מ-Urahafu לחסום את המקלדת. סגור את השדה או האפליקציה הזו, ואז נסה שוב.
trans-unit.note: Body of the Secure-Input-active error alert, suggests closing the app or field responsible.
Default button on error alerts, retries the action.
Cancel button shared by several alerts.

trans-unit.source: Clean your screen and keyboard without triggering anything.
trans-unit.target: נקה את המסך והמקלדת בלי להפעיל שום דבר.
trans-unit.note: Tagline shown in the About alert, under the app name.
License line shown in the About alert.
Secondary button in the About alert, opens the GitHub repository.
Default (OK) button in the About alert.

Keyboard-only mode's countdown label counting down to the keyboard lock, e.g. 'Locking in' 3, 2, 1. {n} is the remaining digit (a single-digit integer, no unit needed unless natural in this language).

trans-unit.source: Space: dead-pixel test · Auto-unlock in {seconds} s
trans-unit.target: Space: בדיקת פיקסלים מתים · שחרור אוטומטי בעוד {seconds} שניות
trans-unit.note: Second line of text on the full-screen cleaning overlay: dead-pixel test hint plus the remaining fail-safe auto-unlock time. {seconds} is the number of seconds left, always shown with plain digits (0-9), never native digit forms.
Version line shown in the About alert, e.g. 'Version 1.0.0'. {version} is the crate's semantic version string, inserted verbatim (never translated or reformatted).
